A timer, not medical advice

Don’t Break Fast is a general wellness timer. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment, and it is not intended for emergencies. Fasting may not be appropriate for everyone. Consult a qualified healthcare professional before fasting if you have questions about your health, and stop if you feel unwell.
